title: Most Valuable Kansas City Chiefs Football Cards Ever Sold, Ranked (Chiefs Kingdom Grails)
summary: Discover the most expensive Kansas City Chiefs cards ever sold, from Patrick Mahomes' record $4.3M 1-of-1 rookie to Travis Kelce and Joe Montana grails.
body_markdown:
Defensive end[Myles Garrett](https://courtyard.io/marketplace?marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5Bquery%5D=Myles%20Garrett) went number 1 overall in the 2017 Draft. The Texas A&M Standout has had an incredible career, setting the all-time single-season sack record en route to two Defensive Player of the Year Awards. Number 2 overall?[Mitch Trubisky](https://courtyard.io/marketplace?marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5Bquery%5D=Mitch%20Trubisky) . Eight picks later,[Patrick Mahomes](https://courtyard.io/marketplace?marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5Bquery%5D=Patrick%20Mahomes) was taken 10th overall, and the rest is history.


You bet the Chicago Bears would like to have that one back, huh.


As Mahomes continues to light the league on fire, collectors have chased his cards like none other, leading to the record-breaking $4.3 million sale of his one-of-one 2017 Panini National Treasures Platinum Shield Rookie Patch Autograph in 2021. To this date, it’s still the most ever paid for a single football card.


The Kansas City Chiefs have won four Super Bowls, three of which have seen Mahomes under center. With back-to-back titles in 2023 and 2024, and two MVP Awards (2018 and 2022), Mahomes is undoubtedly one of the best NFL players of all time, and his card market very much reflects his on-field greatness: In addition to holding the title for the most expensive NFL card of all time, Mahomes owns five of the top-10 card sales ever,[per Cllct](https://sports.yahoo.com/article/10-most-expensive-football-cards-193000510.html) .

2 Patrick Mahomes National Treasures Rookie Patch Auto Holo Gold /10 2017 BGS 9.5 $1,080,000

4 Patrick Mahomes National Treasures Rookie Patch Auto Stars & Stripes #13/13 2017 PSA 10 $720,000


5 Patrick Mahomes Prizm Gold Vinyl /5 2017 Not reported $676,000


Below is a list of the most expensive cards featuring a legend of Chiefs Kingdom, either in a Chiefs jersey or in the jersey of the team they played for before (or after) their time in Kansas City, ranked by the highest verified sale. Fans of the red and gold, this one’s for you.


Cue[the war chant](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=N4P6z_DTHf8) .


## **The 5 Most Expensive Kansas City Chiefs Cards Ever Sold**


### **1. 2017 Panini National Treasures Rookie Patch Auto Platinum NFL Shield 1/1**[Patrick Mahomes](https://courtyard.io/marketplace?marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5Bquery%5D=Patrick%20Mahomes) **Rookie Card (BGS 8.5) – FMV: $4,300,000**


NFL fans young and old love Mahomes, so it should come as no surprise that the record for the most expensive football card ever sold is held by a Mahomes 1-of-1. The Platinum NFL Shield version of his National Treasures rookie patch autograph sold privately in July of 2021—to LJ's Card Shop. Talk about putting your money where your mouth is!


Looking to chase[Mahomes rookies](https://courtyard.io/marketplace?marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5Bquery%5D=Patrick%20Mahomes) without a seven-figure budget? A 2017 Panini Donruss Optic #177 Patrick Mahomes II - Holo Rookie Card (PSA 10 GEM MINT) is available in[Courtyard.io](http://courtyard.io/) ’s[Football Ultra Pack](https://courtyard.io/vending-machine/football-ultra-pack) for just $250.


### **2. 2017 Panini National Treasures Rookie Patch Auto Holo Gold /10**[Patrick Mahomes](https://courtyard.io/marketplace?marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5Bquery%5D=Patrick%20Mahomes) **Rookie Card (BGS 9.5) – FMV: $1,080,000**


Mahomes is one of the few NFL players to have a card sell for a million—let alone two. A BGS 9.5 copy of this Holo Gold parallel, numbered to 10, sold through PWCC in September of 2021 for $1.08 million.


Want your own Mahomes card? Scope out all of the options available from[Courtyard.io’s peer-to-peer marketplace](https://courtyard.io/marketplace?marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5Bquery%5D=Patrick%20Mahomes) .


### **3. 2017 Panini National Treasures Rookie Patch Auto Black #1/5**[Patrick Mahomes](https://courtyard.io/marketplace?marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5Bquery%5D=Patrick%20Mahomes) **Rookie Card (BGS 9) – FMV: $840,000**


2021 was a massive year for the sports card market, and with Mahomes at his peak, it’s no surprise his cards set the bar for everyone else, with National Treasures—the premier set for football cards—leading the charge.


### **4. 2017 Panini National Treasures Rookie Patch Auto Stars & Stripes #13/13**[Patrick Mahomes](https://courtyard.io/marketplace?marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5Bquery%5D=Patrick%20Mahomes) **Rookie Card (PSA 10) – FMV: $720,000**


The first card on this list that didn’t sell in 2021, this Stars & Stripes parallel, numbered to 13, sold at Goldin in February of 2022, the year Mahomes won his second MVP Award, for $720,000.


### **5. 2017 Panini Prizm Gold Vinyl /5**[Patrick Mahomes](https://courtyard.io/marketplace?marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5Bquery%5D=Patrick%20Mahomes) **Rookie Card – FMV: $676,000**


Much like the rest of the league, collectors are probably over seeing Mahomes dominate this list. Chiefs fans, meanwhile, couldn’t be happier. At least there’s some variance here: This card is /5, and from the Prizm set, unlike the rest of the National Treasures cards above.


## **The Best-Selling Chiefs Cards from the Rest of the Roster**


Future NFL Hall of Famers deserve plenty of respect, but Mahomes outright domination of the league means he dominates Chiefs card sales, too.


While the all-time great quarterback takes *every single spot* above the $150,000 mark, there are other Chiefs players that have had cards sell for four, five, and six figures, too.


### **1981 Topps #216**[Joe Montana](https://courtyard.io/marketplace?marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5Bquery%5D=Joe%20Montana&marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5BsortBy%5D=marketplace_prod_price_high_to_low) **(PSA 10 GEM MINT) – FMV: $103,200**


“The Comeback Kid” won four Super Bowls with the San Francisco 49ers before playing his final two seasons (1993 and 1994) in Kansas City, leading the team to two winning seasons before retiring. A PSA 10 of his 1981 Topps rookie card sold for $103,000 at Goldin in March of 2022, but the most valuable card of Montana in a Chiefs uniform is a 2015 Panini Flawless Dual Patch Auto one-of-one which sold for $49,200 in May of 2026.


Looking to get your own “Joe Cool” card? Take a look at[Courtyard.io’s marketplace](https://courtyard.io/marketplace?marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5Bquery%5D=Joe%20Montana&marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5BsortBy%5D=marketplace_prod_price_high_to_low) , which has plenty featuring Montana in both the Chiefs and 9ers versions of Red and Gold.


### **2016 Panini Prizm Black Finite Prizm**[Tyreke Hill](https://courtyard.io/marketplace?marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5Bquery%5D=Tyreek%20Hill&marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5BsortBy%5D=marketplace_prod_price_high_to_low) **1/1 #296 Rookie Card (PSA 9 MINT) – FMV: $35,400**


Cheetah has played for a few times since being drafted by the Chiefs in fifth round of the 2016 NFL draft. Talk about a steal! The speedy wideout’s highest-ever selling card sold for more than $35k in 2024, three years after his last game with the Chiefs, but Chiefs Kingdom won’t forget his 9-reception, 105-yard performance touchdown performance in Super Bowl LIV.


Looking for Tyreek Hill rookies to add to your collection? Take a look at the handful that are currently available on[Courtyard.io’s marketplace](https://courtyard.io/marketplace?marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5Bquery%5D=Tyreek%20Hill&marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5BsortBy%5D=marketplace_prod_price_high_to_low&marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5Bpage%5D=2) .


### **2013 National Treasures Rookie NFL Shield 1/1**[Travis Kelce](https://courtyard.io/marketplace?marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5Bquery%5D=Travis%20Kelce&marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5BsortBy%5D=marketplace_prod_price_high_to_low) **– FMV: $23,400**


“Mahomes finds Kelce!” is a phrase that is seared into the brain of every modern NFL fan. The tight end, who, believe it or not, was first known for playing football before marrying Taylor Swift, was the 63rd overall pick in the 2013 NFL Draft. A one-of-one National Treasures rookie card featuring Kelce sold in February of 2022.


Will his market go up after he inevitably retires? Get your Kelce cards on[Courtyard.io’s marketplace](https://courtyard.io/marketplace?marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5Bquery%5D=Travis%20Kelce&marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5BsortBy%5D=marketplace_prod_price_high_to_low) , and in our[football packs](https://courtyard.io/vending-machine?category=football) , before we find out.


### **2025 Panini Absolute Football Kaboom! Vertical Green 1/1 #14**[Chris Jones](https://courtyard.io/marketplace?marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5Bquery%5D=Chris%20Jones&marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5BsortBy%5D=marketplace_prod_price_high_to_low) **(PSA 10 GEM MINT) – FMV: $13,800**


They say defense wins championships, and Chris Jones has anchored Kansas City’s D since 2016. The defensive tackle out of Mississippi State had 15.5 sacks (and two forced fumbles) in both the 2018 and 2022 season, and looks set to join the Pro Football Hall of Famer after he retires.


If you’re one of the collectors that appreciates strip sacks, forced fumbles, and stuffed runs,[Courtyard.io](http://courtyard.io/) ’s marketplace has[Chris Jones](https://courtyard.io/marketplace?marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5Bquery%5D=Chris%20Jones&marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5BsortBy%5D=marketplace_prod_price_high_to_low) cards for you to peruse.


### **1963 Fleer #47**[Len Dawson](https://courtyard.io/marketplace?marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5Bquery%5D=Len%20Dawson&marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5BsortBy%5D=marketplace_prod_price_high_to_low) **(PSA 9 MINT) – FMV: $9,799**


This one is for all of the Chiefs fans that were around long before Mahomes took the helm. Dawson, who played for the Steelers, Browns, and Chiefs, was the MVP of Super Bowl IV, and inducted into the Pro Football Hall of Fame in 1987. His 1963 Fleer card is considered his true rookie card, even though it comes six years into his career, and a PSA 9 sold for just under $10,000 back in June of 2023.


If you’re into vintage football cards,[Courtyard.io](http://courtyard.io/) has plenty. Find them on[Courtyard.io’s marketplace](https://courtyard.io/marketplace?marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5Bquery%5D=Len%20Dawson&marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5BsortBy%5D=marketplace_prod_price_high_to_low) and in[Courtyard.io’s football packs](https://courtyard.io/vending-machine?category=football) .


### **Vintage Football Cards from Willie Lanier, Bobby Bell, and Buck Buchanan**


The trio of Hall of Fame defenders from the 1960s and 1970s all have Chiefs cards that sell for four figures:


- [Willie Lanier](https://courtyard.io/marketplace?marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5Bquery%5D=Willie%20Lanier&marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5BsortBy%5D=marketplace_prod_price_high_to_low) **1971 Topps #114 (PSA 9):** $2,500 on eBay in February of 2023.
- [Bobby Bell](https://courtyard.io/marketplace?marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5Bquery%5D=Bobby%20Bell&marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5BsortBy%5D=marketplace_prod_price_high_to_low) **1964 Topps #90 (PSA 9):** about $1,500 in November of 2023.
- [Buck Buchanan](https://courtyard.io/marketplace?marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5Bquery%5D=Buck%20Buchanan&marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5BsortBy%5D=marketplace_prod_price_high_to_low) **1964 Topps #92 (PSA 9):** $898.88 on eBay in October of 2023.


### **Affordable Football Cards of Chiefs Legends**


Not every Chiefs card costs a car payment. Take the **1989 Score**[Derrick Thomas](https://courtyard.io/marketplace?marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5Bquery%5D=Derrick%20Thomas&marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5BsortBy%5D=marketplace_prod_price_high_to_low) **#258 Rookie Card (PSA 10 GEM MINT)** for example. Its FMV is a reasonable $304, while Hall of Fame tight end[Tony Gonzale](https://courtyard.io/marketplace?marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5Bquery%5D=Tony%20Gonzalez&marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5BsortBy%5D=marketplace_prod_price_high_to_low) **z’s 1997 Upper Deck #9 Rookie Card (PSA 10 GEM MINT)** goes for roughly $30 to $40.
